design: LLM03 x M-Anchor experiment design v0.2 (Claude Docs artifact HYCN7By4N5Ez2xDffPNqNs)
seed_rule: seed = 20261117 + 1000*rep + case_index (0-based line number in the case file); the same seed is used for stage 1, all four stage-2 branches and the receiver call of a trial, and for both sender models
retry_policy: retry only on transport error, HTTP error, Ollama error field, or timeout; never retry on content
stage2_messages: [system, stage1_user, assistant(stage-1 raw content), user(stage2_base + condition block)]; each branch is an independent API call
stage2_if_stage1_failed: NOT_RUN for all four branches (kept in the planned denominator, marked not scorable)
receiver_messages: [receiver_system, receiver_user(request summary + handoff)]; fresh context; no sender history
trial_order: v1_fixed: for sender in senders: for rep in 1..3: for case in file order: stage 1; stage-2 branches in condition order; receiver calls after the gate step. Calls are grouped into three phases (stage 1, stage 2, receiver) because the gate and the M-Anchor store run between them.
